8.3.96 EthIf_SwitchMacSecResetRxSc
[SWS_EthIf_91221]{DRAFT} Definition of API function EthIf_SwitchMacSecReset
RxSc ⌈
Service Name
EthIf_SwitchMacSecResetRxSc (DRAFT)
Syntax
Std_ReturnType EthIf_SwitchMacSecResetRxSc (
const EthSwt_MgmtInfoType* MgmtInfoPtr,
uint64 Sci
)
Service ID [hex]
0x6f
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different MgmtInfoPtr, Non reentrant for the same MgmtInfoPtr
MgmtInfoPtr
Pointer to the management information within the context of an
Ethernet Switch Driver. SwitchIdx in context of EthIf, PortIdx in
context of EthSwt.
Parameters (in)
Sci
Secure Channel Identifier for the MACsec’s Reception Secure
channel
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: The request has been accepted E_NOT_OK: The request
has not been accepted
Description
Requests the Ethernet Switch Driver to reset to default the MACsec values of the Reception
Secure Channel for the given Secure Channel Identifier.
Tags: atp.Status=DRAFT
Available via
EthIf.h
⌋()
